title: On Scope Classification and Current Knowledge-Editing Benchmarks: A Negative Result, with INLAY as a Gradient-Free Case Study
abstract: arXiv:2608.26292v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Every memory-based knowledge editor in the SERAC lineage depends on a scope decision: given a query, does a stored edit apply? We report that current knowledge-editing benchmarks cannot measure this decision at all. Using INLAY, a gradient-free editor we built to obtain exact per-query ground truth (the model is frozen, edits live in an external addressable memory, and applying an edit is a bias added along one token's unembedding direction at decode time), we execute every candidate router action on 1,689 queries spanning three datasets and three input conditions. An oracle router choosing the best action every time ties a one-line static policy to four decimal places in all nine dataset-by-condition cells: the maximum attainable gain of any per-query routing method is 0.00 points. Abstention is the sole winning action zero times out of 1,689. The cause is structural: these are counterfactual benchmarks whose evaluation question asks

translated_title: 关于范围分类与当前知识编辑基准：一项负面结果，以INLAY作为无梯度案例研究
translated_abstract: arXiv:2608.26292v1 公告类型：交叉 摘要：SERAC系列中每个基于记忆的知识编辑器都依赖于一个范围决策：给定一个查询，存储的编辑是否适用？我们报告称，当前的知识编辑基准根本无法衡量这一决策。使用INLAY——我们构建的一个无梯度编辑器，以获得精确的每查询地面真实值（模型被冻结，编辑存在于外部可寻址记忆中，应用编辑是在解码时沿一个令牌的解除嵌入方向添加的偏置）——我们在涵盖三个数据集和三种输入条件的1,689个查询上执行了每个候选路由动作。一个选择每次最佳动作的神谕路由器在所有九个数据集-条件单元格中将一个单行静态策略的精度持平到小数点后四位：任何每查询路由方法的最大可获得增益为0.00分。弃权是唯一获胜动作，在1,689次中零次成功。原因是结构性的：这些是反事实基准，其评估问题询问...
tldr: 当前知识编辑基准无法衡量范围分类决策，因为所有测试场景中任何路由方法的最大收益为零，表明这些基准存在结构性缺陷。
en_tdlr: Current knowledge-editing benchmarks fail to measure scope classification, as the maximum attainable gain of any routing method is zero across all tested scenarios, indicating a structural flaw in these benchmarks.
